hook: Bonus Hour is a fixed window, not a timer.

points.label: When
points.body: Round 1 only: 9:00–10:00 PM ET, everyone gets double points.

points.label: The trap
points.body: Go LIVE at 9:50 and it still ends at 10:00. Start early.

points.label: No stacking
points.body: A Double Blast doesn't add on top of Bonus Hour. Save it.

hook: Your daily Double Blast expires at midnight.

points.label: What it does
points.body: Doubles gift and vote points for 30 minutes.

points.label: One at a time
points.body: Only one Double Blast can run at once.

points.label: The trap
points.body: The daily one is gone at midnight. Bonus ones you earn last to the Finale.

takeaway: Use it or lose it, every day.

hook: Not every gift counts the same in LIVE Fest.

points.label: FEST + Vault
points.body: FEST and Vault gifts count DOUBLE points.

points.label: Names change
points.body: Some slides show other gift names. The double rule stays the same.

points.label: Where to look
points.body: The LIVE Fest banner in the TikTok app has the live rules and leaderboards.

hook: US Round 2 moved. Check your dates.

points.label: The trap
points.body: Matches set on the old dates need to move.

hook: In Rounds 2 and 3, only your best match counts.

points.label: Daily bonus
points.body: Your highest score from a full 5-minute match is added each day.

points.label: Full matches
points.body: It has to be a full 5 minutes. Matches are unlimited.

points.label: Midnight
points.body: A match that crosses midnight counts for the earlier day.

takeaway: Play full matches, chase one big score.
